newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss currency trade closed for Easter.
newsitem.headline: Swiss currency trade closed for Easter.

text.p: Swiss currency trade was closed on Friday, March 28, and will remain closed on Monday, March 31, for Easter holidays.
Trade will resume on Tuesday, April 1.
* On Thursday the dollar closed lower at 1.4542/4548 Swiss francs versus 1.4670/4680 francs on Wednesday.
* The mark ended lower at 86.55/57 Swiss centimes versus 86.68/70 centimes on Wednesday. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
